title: TNBC chromatin-informed regulatory framework transfer pilot

anchor.title: A chromatin-informed transcriptional regulatory framework to stratify patients and guide therapy selection in triple-negative breast cancer

goal.success_definition: A reviewed pilot outcome with traceable direction, data, code, minimal real execution and recorded workflow feedback

constraints.compute: All real data processing and analysis must run on the project cloud server under /media/desk16/iy13202/projects/Paper2Paper; the local checkout is limited to source materials, Git-tracked specifications, code, compact results and reports.

stop_rule: LUAD Figure 2 FAIL_DATA on 2026-08-14: all 19 strict LUAD cell-line ATAC libraries were processed under the frozen hard QC; 14 passed and 5 failed (26.32%), exceeding the pre-registered maximum failure fraction of 20%. The 22-patient TCGA open matrix was audited. All 13 PDX raw datasets were downloaded, but after the cell-line gate locked, one active PDX job was stopped with an explicit receipt and the remaining 12 were not launched; neither category is counted as a PDX QC failure. Figure 2, Supplementary Figure 3 and Supplementary Figure 4A-C are NOT_GENERATED_DUE_FAIL_DATA; promoter, motif, robustness and Figure 3 analyses were not evaluated. Figure 1 clinical/molecular annotations and Supplementary Figures 1-2 remain independently verified PASS. Stop here; do not rescue by changing thresholds, samples or LUAD comparison.
